impact.text: The `unregisterVault()` function in `WERC7575ShareToken` can be permanently blocked by sending 1 wei of the underlying asset directly to the vault address.

precondition_sources.text: A vault is registered in the WERC7575ShareToken vault registry.

intent_sources.text: unregisterVault() must not be blocked by excess underlying tokens sent directly to the vault that are not backed by shares; the check should reflect internal accounting (totalAssets()) rather than external balanceOf().

formalizability.reason: The explicit P/I source selection is recorded; formula validity remains unassessed.

impact.text: this allows an attacker to fill all registry slots and then "dust" each vault, permanently locking the vault registry.

precondition_sources.text: A vault is registered in the WERC7575ShareToken vault registry.

intent_sources.text: The vault registry must not be permanently locked by filling all MAX_VAULTS_PER_SHARE_TOKEN slots and dusting each vault.
